senses.gloss: निज् vt. or vi. 3U (pp. निक्त; pres. नेनेक्ति, नेनेक्ते, प्रणेनेक्ति) 1. To wash, to cleanse, to purify; 2. to be purified; 3. to nourish.With अव-, to wash, to sprinkle water.With निस्-, to clean, to purify, to wash, M.v.127, R.xvii.22.
निज a. (f. जा) 1. Innate, native, congenital; 2. own, relating to oneself, of one’s own party, R.iii.15, xviii.28; 3. peculiar; 4. continual, perpetual.
